verdict.rationale: Resend documents its own activity visualization, delivery-event monitoring, broadcast click retrieval, and a managed dedicated-IP warmup and monitoring service. That gives a thin base of engagement and delivery data, but nothing in the evidence explicitly shows bounce or complaint analytics, and nothing shows guidance beyond raw events. Missing for 10: explicit bounce and complaint rate analytics, inbox placement insights, sender reputation guidance or scoring, open/engagement dashboards beyond broadcast link clicks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can see bounce, complaint, and engagement analytics with guidance on inbox placement and sender reputation, not just raw counts

citations.quote: Visualize all the activity in your account.
Retrieve the links clicked in a broadcast
We will warmup, monitor, and autoscale it based on your utilization
